title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
description: From painting the iconic mountain to the lighting of lanterns, Arizona State University's traditions are deeply rooted in its desert history and Sun Devil spirit.

cards.title: Echo from the Buttes
cards.subtitle: Whitewashing the 'A' Mountain
cards.notes: Hike up Hayden Butte during Welcome Week to paint the 60-foot concrete 'A' white, symbolizing a fresh start for the incoming class.
cards.short_summary: A Welcome Week tradition where freshmen hike Hayden Butte to paint the iconic 'A' white.
cards.evidence_claim: Echo from the Buttes is a cherished, 80-plus-year tradition where incoming first-year students hike up 'A' Mountain to paint the letter white each August.
cards.source_title: Echo from the Buttes: Honoring tradition, culture and heritage
cards.access_notes: Open to all incoming students during Fall Welcome Week; requires a hike up the butte.

cards.title: Lantern Walk
cards.subtitle: A Century-Old Homecoming Ritual
cards.notes: Carry a lantern to the top of 'A' Mountain on the Friday night before the Homecoming game to hear speakers and see the royalty coronation.
cards.short_summary: One of ASU's oldest traditions, where students and alumni carry lanterns up 'A' Mountain before Homecoming.
cards.evidence_claim: Lantern Walk was first celebrated in 1917 and involves students and alumni climbing to the top of 'A' Mountain carrying lanterns on the Friday night before the Homecoming game.
cards.access_notes: Held annually on the Friday night of Homecoming week.

cards.title: Ringing the Victory Bell
cards.subtitle: Commemorating Sun Devil Triumphs
cards.notes: Watch the Victory Bell Honor Guard ring the portable 150-pound bell after every home win to celebrate the team's success.
cards.short_summary: A restored 1930s tradition where a bell is rung to celebrate athletic victories.
cards.evidence_claim: The Victory Bell tradition dates back to the 1930s and was restored in 2012 with a new 150-pound bell that is rung after every Sun Devil triumph.
cards.source_title: Sun Devil Athletics brings back Victory Bell in return to tradition
cards.access_notes: The bell is present at home football games and other major athletic events.

cards.title: Touching the Tillman Statue
cards.subtitle: Honoring a Sun Devil Legend
cards.notes: Observe the football team touch the 7.5-foot bronze statue of Pat Tillman as they charge through the tunnel onto Frank Kush Field.
cards.short_summary: A pre-game ritual where players touch the Pat Tillman statue for inspiration.
cards.evidence_claim: Unveiled in 2017, the Pat Tillman statue stands in front of the Tillman Tunnel, and players touch it as they charge onto the field to honor his legacy.
cards.access_notes: Located at the north end of Mountain America Stadium; visible during games.

cards.title: Camp Tontozona
cards.subtitle: Preseason Training in the Pines
cards.notes: Follow the team to the Mogollon Rim for grueling preseason practices, a tradition started by Coach Frank Kush in 1960.
cards.short_summary: The annual preseason football training camp held in the mountains near Payson, Arizona.
cards.evidence_claim: Camp Tontozona, or 'Camp T,' began in 1960 under Coach Frank Kush and continues as an annual August preseason training tradition for the football team.
cards.source_title: Bonding, bunk beds and ... a dead bat? An oral history of Camp Tontozona
cards.access_notes: Located 17.9 miles outside of Payson; fans often travel to watch the final practice.

cards.title: Forks Up
cards.subtitle: The Universal Sun Devil Greeting
cards.notes: Extend your index, middle, and pinky fingers to form the pitchfork sign, the standard gesture of school spirit and greeting.
cards.short_summary: The iconic hand gesture representing Sparky's pitchfork and Sun Devil pride.
cards.evidence_claim: 'Forks Up' is the hand sign inspired by Sparky's pitchfork and is an essential part of ASU traditions and game day culture.
cards.source_title: Sun Devil Traditions | ASU Sun Devil Athletics
cards.access_notes: Used campus-wide and at all athletic events.

cards.title: Sparky's Push-ups
cards.subtitle: Scoring with the Mascot
cards.notes: Count along as Sparky the Sun Devil performs one push-up for every point on the scoreboard after each ASU touchdown.
cards.short_summary: A game day tradition where the mascot performs push-ups corresponding to the team's score.
cards.evidence_claim: When the Sun Devils score a touchdown, Sparky does one pushup for every point on the scoreboard while the crowd counts.
cards.source_title: Sun Devil Traditions | ASU Sun Devil Athletics
cards.access_notes: Occurs during home football games at Mountain America Stadium.

cards.title: Stomp the Bus
cards.subtitle: A Thunderstruck Entrance
cards.notes: Watch the video board as Sparky 'crushes' the opposing team's bus to the tune of AC/DC's 'Thunderstruck' before the team enters.
cards.short_summary: A pre-game video tradition where Sparky stomps on the opponent's bus.
cards.evidence_claim: Sparky leaves the opposing team 'thunderstruck' when he crushes their bus on the video board to welcome Sun Devil Football onto the field.
cards.source_title: Sun Devil Traditions | ASU Sun Devil Athletics
cards.access_notes: Played on the stadium big screen just before the team takes the field.

cards.title: Guarding the 'A'
cards.subtitle: Rivalry Week Vigilance
cards.notes: Join the Student Alumni Association in camping out on Hayden Butte to protect the 'A' from being painted by rival U of A students.
cards.short_summary: A rivalry week tradition where students protect the 'A' from vandals.
cards.evidence_claim: Every year during the rivalry football game week, the Student Alumni Association guards the 'A' from being painted by University of Arizona students.
cards.access_notes: Occurs during the week leading up to the Territorial Cup game.

cards.title: Sun Devil Walk
cards.subtitle: Greeting the Team
cards.notes: Line the path on College Avenue two hours before kickoff to cheer on the players, Sparky, and the band as they head to the stadium.
cards.short_summary: The pre-game procession of the football team and marching band through campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Sun Devil Walk welcomes the football team to the stadium before the game with Sparky, the Spirit Squad, and the Sun Devil Marching Band.
cards.source_title: Sun Devil Traditions | ASU Sun Devil Athletics
cards.access_notes: Takes place on College Avenue approximately two and a half hours before home games.
